about: L&T Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financial products and services in India. It offers housing loans; personal loans for medical emergencies, home renovation, wedding, vacation, education, and debt consolidation; two-wheeler loans; business loans, such as SME, doctor, chartered accountant, and professional loans, as well as supply chain financing solutions; rural loans comprising vikaas loans, vishwas loans, pragati loans, RLAP balance transfer, and micro loan
